what.text: This page follows refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 24653 refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Serbia and Kosovo hosts the largest share, 31.2%, followed by France, Denmark and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Serb territory in Bosnia-Herzegovina from 1992 to 1995, at war level, with the Serbian Republic of Bosnia-Herzegovina and Serbian irregulars.
It also records armed conflict over Croat territory from 1992 to 1994 and over Bihaca Krajina territory from 1993 to 1995.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1992 at 437501 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 993868, at the end of 1996, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1993 to 2000.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
